stemMd: Why does the report avoid the broad term “soundproof”?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Door seals cannot influence sound transmission

options.label: B
options.textMd: The term describes only a room’s colour

options.label: C
options.textMd: The report contains no useful measurements

options.label: D
options.textMd: It would overstate what the measurements demonstrated

options.label: E
options.textMd: The team decided that quietness never matters

explanationMd: A broad label can imply comprehensive isolation that the initial measurement did not establish. Naming the measured property makes the evidence and its limits clearer. It avoids converting one improvement into an unsupported general guarantee.

distractorRationale.e: The interventions aimed to improve the reading environment.
distractorRationale.b: Its problem here is the breadth of the acoustic claim.
